D: A thirteen-year-old makes a birthday wish and wakes up as a thirty-year-old magazine editor.
P: Serve the snacks when Jenna gets the whole party dancing.
S: Jenna's thirteenth birthday party in the basement

Popcorn bound in a sticky marshmallow and butter glaze, packed with chopped sour straps and jelly beans, rolled into balls and wrapped like party favours. Pop 100g popcorn kernels and tip into a big bowl, discarding unpopped kernels. Melt 50g butter in a saucepan over low heat, add 250g marshmallows and stir until smooth. Pour over the popcorn with 100g chopped sour straps and 80g jelly beans and fold quickly. With buttered hands, press into 12 tennis ball sized rounds. Set on baking paper for 30 minutes, then wrap in cellophane.
the wishing dust from Matt's dream house
Sugar cookies baked at 180C for 10 minutes, iced pale pink and dusted with edible glitter.
Poise party salmon blinis and melon
the Poise magazine party where Jenna gets the room dancing

Warm blinis with dill crème fraîche, smoked salmon and salmon roe, beside rockmelon wedges wrapped in prosciutto and cracked pepper, served on silver trays. Warm 16 blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 150ml crème fraîche with 1 tbsp chopped dill and a squeeze of lemon. Top each blini with a spoon of the cream, a fold of smoked salmon (200g total) and a few beads of salmon roe. Cut half a rockmelon into 12 thin wedges, peel and wrap each in half a slice of prosciutto (6 slices). Grind over pepper and arrange both on trays.
M: Mum's lemon and thyme roast chook
Jenna going home to her parents' house

Whole chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and thyme until the skin crackles, with crunchy roast potatoes, buttered green beans and pan gravy. Heat the oven to 200C. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 30g soft butter, salt and pepper. Stuff with 1 halved lemon, 4 garlic cloves and a bunch of thyme. Parboil 1kg quartered potatoes for 8 minutes, drain, rough up and toss in oil. Roast the chicken 75 minutes and the potatoes alongside for 60 minutes. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Whisk 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices with 300ml stock for gravy. Boil 300g green beans 4 minutes and toss with butter.

Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, broccoli and capsicum in a sticky soy and honey sauce, in takeaway boxes. Stir-fry 500g sliced chicken thighs until browned. Add broccoli florets and a sliced red capsicum and cook 3 minutes. Toss through 400g cooked egg noodles with soy sauce and honey until sticky. Pack into takeaway boxes.
W: the cake at Jenna's thirteenth birthday

Two layers of vanilla butter sponge filled with raspberry jam, covered in pink buttercream and rolled in rainbow sprinkles, thirteen candles on top. Heat the oven to 175C. Beat 200g soft butter and 200g caster sugar until pale, then 4 eggs one at a time and 1 tsp vanilla. Fold in 250g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Divide between two lined 20cm tins and bake 30 minutes. Cool. Beat 250g butter with 450g icing sugar, 2 tbsp milk and a drop of pink colouring. Sandwich the layers with 150g raspberry jam, ice all over and press sprinkles around the sides.
K: Pineapple juice blended with coconut cream and ice, with a splash of white rum for the adults. Blend 500ml pineapple juice with 200ml coconut cream and a big handful of ice until thick and smooth. Pour into glasses for the kids. Add 30ml white rum to each glass for the grown-ups who turned thirty overnight.
